data.title: querier.matching_listener not work
data.body:
### Describe the bug

`querier.matching_listener` not work after  https://github.com/eclipse-zenoh/zenoh/pull/2135 . `publisher.matching_listener` still works well.

I’ve tried to figure out what happens when a querable is closed. Below are some observations/clues related to the problem:
After the face(queryable) is closed, [update_queryable_info](https://github.com/eclipse-zenoh/zenoh/blob/main/zenoh/src/net/routing/hat/client/queries.rs#L216) outputs 

> Request to update QueryableInfo for inexistent face id:xxx

and returns `false`, then the`UndeclareQueryable` will not be processed by session.  Finally, the matching_status will not be update.

[zenoh-plugin-ros2dds](https://github.com/eclipse-zenoh/zenoh-plugin-ros2dds) uses querier matching status to create dds writers/readers for ros2 service server. ROS messages will not be routed if the peer restart because the matching status is not updated.

### To reproduce

Using examples: [z_querier](https://github.com/eclipse-zenoh/zenoh/blob/main/examples/examples/z_querier.rs) and [z_queryable](https://github.com/eclipse-zenoh/zenoh/blob/main/examples/examples/z_queryable.rs)
1. Starting `z_queryable` with cmd: 

> ./z_queryable -l udp/0.0.0.0:9600 -m **peer** -k test/query -p 123

2. Starting `z_querier` with cmd: 

> ./z_querier -e udp/0.0.0.0:9600 -m **client** -s test/query --add-matching-listener

3. `z_querier` will output: **Querier has matching queryables.**

> Opening session...
> Declaring Querier on 'test/query'...
> Press CTRL-C to quit...
> **Querier has matching queryables.**
> Querying 'test/query' with payload: '[   0] '...
>  \>\> Received ('test/query': '123')

4. Stopping `z_queryable` and waiting for a while.
5. `z_querier` will not show: **Querier has NO MORE matching queryables.**
7. Restarting `z_queryable`.
8. `z_querier`will not show: **Querier has matching queryables.**

### System info

- Platform: All platforms.
- Zenoh: f604d5c98218b8e44bccacac568e99b53d10f5d7
